Name: Elegant Craftables for Alternative Textures
Author: itzyitzme
Description:
[b][u]THS MOD REQUIRES ALTERNATIVE TEXTURES V6.10.4 OR HIGHER.[/u][/b]

Collingbe was kind enough to allow me to convert their gorgeous-looking [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11693]Elegant Craftables[/url]﻿ to Alternative Textures, and after a few days of figuring out how to even convert them, I pulled through! All credits go to them and their mod, all I did was convert it. For a complete list of what changes, visit the original mod page [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11693]here[/url]﻿.

[b][i]You can search for this pack's retextures with the keyword 'Elegant'[/i]
[/b]
I tried my best to adjust the speed of the animated retextures, but do let me know if you think anything is too fast or too slow, and I'll see if I can change it.

To use this pack, you need to buy the paint bucket from Robin and click on an item while you have the paint bucket equipped. If you notice random texture changes when you place an object, make sure to set UseRandomTextureWhenPlacingObjects to [u][i]false[/i][/u], then use the paint bucket to apply the texture you want.

[b]
Known bugs:
[/b][i]- [s]The Wood Chipper doesn't retexture.[/s][/i] [b]Supported with Alternative Textures v6.7.0+
[/b]- [i]The animated crabpots flicker in and out of existence when they're full of bait. [/i]This is a problem with Alternative Textures itself, and the fix may not come until 1.6. For now, use the [u][b]non-animated version[/b][/u].
- The Pressure Nozzle and the Enricher wouldn't show up on top of the retextured sprinklers, so I removed them from the conversion. If you'd like to change those textures, you can use the CP version.


Everything else should be working as expected! Feel free to leave a comment if something doesn't and I'll figure it out.
